title: 第19章 要宋荞出丑第20章 不得入内
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
第19章要宋荞出丑
“这个球不够圆，重做！”
一爪子过去。
“这片木头处理得不够光滑！重做！”
又一爪子过去。
“这么慢是什么意思？故意跟我作对吗？”
还是一爪子。
日光猫冷哼着，那边宋荞是个狗腿子，黎漠是狗腿子的狗腿子，这两人他暂时没办法。
楚风眠和林颜，本身就作了大死，顺便承受一下他的怒火！这没有任何问题吧？
在日光猫的监督下。
楚风眠和林颜连一秒钟休息的时间都没有，这也就算了，日光猫时不时就要给他们来上一爪。
虽然日光猫没想要他们的命，已经是收了力，但他们的脸上身上，还是被划出了一道道血痕。
宋荞忙到一半的时候，看了一眼那边的情况，不由就乐了。
这两人早上的时候，还拽得二五八万的。现在，他们身上的衣服都被抓成了碎布条，隐约还能看见肌肤上的一道道血痕。
啧啧啧，真惨啊！
宋荞幸灾乐祸地太明显，楚风眠咬了咬牙，忍不住说道：“神兽大人！那宋荞也在偷懒！你怎么不骂她？”
日光猫：“……”
呵呵。
哪壶不开提哪壶！
他是不想骂吗？啊？

日光猫恼羞成怒，又给了楚风眠一爪子。
楚风眠的脸上，顿时沁出了一行血珠。
“好啊，你还有时间盯着别人。我还是对你太宽容了。”日光猫咧着嘴，露出几颗森冷的牙齿。
楚风眠：“……”
区别对待地这么明显吗？！
“楚师兄，别说话了，先把活干完。”林颜轻声说道。
她比楚风眠识趣一点，身上的伤痕也比楚风眠少许多。
楚风眠只能心不甘情不愿地点了点头。
终于。
他们熬到了太阳西沉。
众所周知，太阳落下后，就是月光猫的修炼时间，她修炼的时候，一向不喜欢有外人在。
楚风眠和林颜不由长长松了一口气。
正好，他们的复原工作，也已经完成了。
今日的折磨，终于是结束了。
“行了，滚吧！以后，别再让我看见你们两个。见一次，我打一次。”日光猫挥舞了一下爪子。
楚风眠和林颜赶忙应了下来，两人怨毒地看了一眼宋荞，转身就是落荒而逃。
宋荞只当他们是羡慕妒忌恨，她回头和月光猫汇报：“神兽大人，隧道工程已经完成了三分之一，再有两日，就能彻底完工。”
月光猫看着纯木打造的这条巨大隧道，眸底闪过了一丝满意。
虽然只是完成了一部分，但她已经有一种钻进去的冲动。
当然。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Wanting Song Qiao to make a fool of himself
"This ball is not round enough, redo it!"
One paw passed.
"This piece of wood is not smooth enough! Redo it!"
Another paw passed.
"What do you mean by being so slow? Are you deliberately going against me?"
Still a paw.
Sunlight Cat snorted coldly, Song Qiao over there is a bitch, Li Mo is a bitch, there is nothing he can do about these two people for the time being.
Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan had committed great deaths themselves, so they could bear his wrath by the way! There's nothing wrong with that, right?
Under the supervision of daylight cats.
Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan didn't even have a second to rest, so forget it, the sunshine cat would give them a claw from time to time.
Although the Sunlight Cat did not want their lives and had already withdrawn its strength, there were still blood marks on their faces and bodies.
When Song Qiao was halfway busy, he took a look at the situation over there and couldn't help but feel happy.
In the morning, these two people even got 2,500,000 to 80,000 yuan. Now, their clothes were cut into rags, and there were faint traces of blood on their skin.
Tsk, tsk, tsk, how miserable!
Song Qiao's gloating was so obvious that Chu Fengmian gritted his teeth and couldn't help but said: "Master Divine Beast! Then Song Qiao is also lazy! Why don't you scold her?"
Sunlight Cat: "..."
Haha.
Which pot won’t be opened?
Doesn't he want to scold? ah?
The Sunlight Cat became angry and gave Chu Fengmian another paw.
A line of blood suddenly appeared on Chu Fengmian's face.
"Okay, you still have time to stare at others. I'm still too tolerant of you." The Sunshine Cat grinned, revealing a few cold teeth.
Chu Fengmian: "..."
Is the difference in treatment so obvious? !
"Senior Brother Chu, stop talking and finish your work first." Lin Yan said softly.
She is more knowledgeable than Chu Fengmian, and has fewer scars on her body than Chu Fengmian.
Chu Fengmian could only nod reluctantly.
finally.
They stayed up until the sun set.
As we all know, after the sun sets, it is Moonlight Cat's training time. She never likes to have outsiders around when she is practicing.
Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan couldn't help but let out a long sigh of relief.
Fortunately, their recovery work has been completed.
Today's torture is finally over.
"Okay, get out! Don't let me see you two again. Once you see me, I'll beat you once." Sunshine Cat waved its paw.
Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan responded quickly. They glanced at Song Qiao bitterly, turned around and ran away.
Song Qiao only thought that they were envious and jealous. She turned around and reported to Moonlight Cat: "Master Divine Beast, one-third of the tunnel project has been completed. In two days, it will be completely completed."
Moonlight Cat looked at this huge tunnel made of pure wood, a trace of satisfaction flashed in his eyes.
Although it was only partially completed, she already had the urge to get in.
certainly.
